messages:
Maya: Mini challenge idea — 'Urban Vertical' this Friday after work? quick 30-45m crag hop + stair sprints. low commit, high fun :mountain:

Oliver: sounds sick. what time are folks thinking?

Samir: I can do 6:30pm. low-key boulder goals: try a V3 I've been eyeing.

Jess: 6:30 works. also can we do a short warmup jog? hate showing up cold :sweat_smile: 

Leo: I'm in if there's a route with an overhang 😅

Maya: ok plan: meet at 6:15 at 3rd St parking lot, 20min jog warmup, then boulder rotations. bring crash pad if you have one. who's bringing pads/cars?

Oliver: I have a spare pad and trunk space. @Jess can you bring chalk?

Jess: yep i've got chalk + tape. also pro tip: quick mobility loop in the warmup — 2x (10 leg swings, 10 arm circles, 30s hip openers)

Samir: running note: my watch says last climb day HR spikes. anyone else see weird strap readings?

Leo: yeah my strap was off on Tuesday. switch to chest strap for intervals.

Maya: quick poll — stair sprints after the crag? 6 rounds x 20 steps? :muscle:

Oliver: in but let's make it optional, don't want to push newbies.

Jess: :thumbsup: optional is good. also bringing protein bars for post-send snack. flavor preferences?

Samir: peanut butter bar pls.

RunBot: Reminder: local crag parking closes at 8pm. Route map: https://tiny.url/cragmap

Maya: awesome, see you Friday. Anyone want to carpool from the office at 5:45?

Leo: i can pick up @Samir & @Maya.

Oliver: if it's raining, contingency: gym boulder comp at the office block — 7pm. same low-key vibe.

Jess: sounds perfect. excited! :grin:

Maya: Checklist:
```
- meetup 6:15 @ 3rd St lot
- warmup jog 10-15m
- pads/chalk/carpool
- stair sprints optional
- post-climb snacks
```

Oliver: bringing an extra headlamp just in case it runs late.

Samir: thanks all, pumped. see you Friday!
